# Creatio | Product Overview

Creatio is an AI-native CRM and code-free automation platform that covers sales, marketing, and services with an emphasis on combined applications and enterprise processes. The product core creates a unified workspace around customer relationships, sales execution and revenue processes, reducing dispersed tools and manual maintenance.
